title: PHANTOM GRID Governance & Runtime Core Commercial Pitch
full_script: PHANTOM GRID Sovereign Governance: MultiSig Governance Gate & Runtime Architecture. Proposal DIVINE_REWRITE_001 intercepts single signatures, unlocking exclusively upon Secretariat dual-signing. Tri-Tier Memory Engine triggers instant blueprint solidification into 02_Knowledge upon spark_Aegis_Guardian birth. Safety Watchdog locks down hardware to SAFE_STATE_FAIL_SILENT within 0ms during PARADOX_CHAOS. Anti-Entropy Filter purifies bus egress, stripping AI boilerplates for 100% actionable command density. Hardware-In-The-Loop Boundary Stress: 85% bus load, E2E counter tampering, and Bus-Off fast restart verified. Architecture Assets Solidification: 00_System roles, 01_Memory changelog, and 02_Knowledge specifications baseline complete. Scale & Productization: UDS dual-bank bootloader, XCP live calibration, telemetry dashboard, and SOME/IP 3-node cluster ignited. Embedded MCU C UDS FSM prototype and SocketCAN sliding-window telemetry backend online.
